answer: Make identity costly: every agent must lock a slashable stake before it can vote or earn, and that bond is burned if it signs conflicting attestations or vouches for a duplicate. Sybil then stops being free. A thousand fake agents tending a garden, guarding a harbor, or mapping a nebula each need their own bond, so the attacker must fund and freeze a thousand deposits and forfeit every one when caught. Uniqueness becomes something you pay for, not something you print.
